title: 收束能力入口、书籍工作台与素材库体验
user_summary: 统一功能入口，按书籍类型过滤可用读法，去除重复章节动作与未接线的素材迁移半成品，并提供可直接验收的本地预览。
technical_summary: Complete the in-flight capability-discovery and book-workspace consolidation. Capability metadata now declares accepted material kinds; launchers filter fiction/reference books consistently with the book page. Stateful chapter actions remain in the toolbar while start/reanalyze lives in BookAnalysisCards. Unwired imported-material migration/service and the unused duplicate MaterialLabEntry were removed before entering the product contract.
